title: CECP Omega lineage record
description: Lean machine-readable handoff for a CECP trail. Status: declared shape; not CI-validated unless a consumer is added. Optional cognitiveProfile / cognitiveSwitches record Cognitive Ecology Ω∞ Profile assignment (docs/governance/cecp/COGNITIVE_ECOLOGY.md) — partial docs/skills, not runtime-enforced. New trails should include engineer_standards / esfr (stage 06); historical 01–05 trails remain valid without it. ESFR package: docs/governance/esfr/.

lineage.default: Architecture → Build → Implementation → Review → Inspection → ESFR

cognitiveProfile.description: Optional primary Cognitive Ecology Profile (docs/governance/cecp/COGNITIVE_ECOLOGY.md). Trail field alias: cognitive-profile. Status: partial docs/skills — not runtime-enforced.

cognitiveSwitches.description: Optional logged Profile switches; each entry needs an evidence cite. Trail field alias: cognitive-switches. Adaptive switching is a declared pattern until measured.

engineerStandardsVerdict.description: Alias of esfrVerdict for older consumers

from.description: Prior Profile name, or null at first assignment

evidence.description: Explicit evidence cite (path, test, probe, or stage artifact) — required for every switch

stage.description: Optional CECP stage when the switch occurred

predecessor.description: Prior stage name or null for architect

artifact.description: Relative path under the trail directory

actorMode.description: Optional Wave 3 CECP Actor Mode (docs/governance/cecp/CECP_ACTOR_MODES.md), e.g. navigator, librarian. Distinct from cognitiveProfile.

softwareCreationMode.description: Optional Wave 4 Software-Creation Mode (docs/governance/cecp/SOFTWARE_CREATION_MODES.md), e.g. pipeline-conductor, boundary-guardian. Distinct from cognitiveProfile and actorMode.

lens.description: Optional mode/lens alias recorded on trail (crew, Actor, or Software-Creation Mode)
